units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 2:25">Targ. Koh. II, 25</cite>.—

<cite ref="Yoma 83b:14">Yoma 83ᵇ</cite> <he>אימר דאמרי אנא ח׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>למֵיחַשׁ</he>, v. <cite ref="H01869">preced.</cite>) what I said (that a name was an omen) was meant only as an apprehension, but I did not mean it as a certainty.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 36a:1">Bekh. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>אימר דאמר ר״מ לח׳</he> what R. M. said, was meant as an apprehension (worth investigating), but not to make one legally disqualified.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 36a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ הוא</he> it is merely a suspicion, <he>ובמקום ח׳ וכ׳</he> and against such a doubt, we may argue that he had no reason to tell a falsehood.
<cite ref="Niddah 17b:23">Nidd. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>אי בתר ח׳ וכ׳</he> if you are guided by a doubt, opp. <cite ref="H00556"><he>חֲזָקָה</he></cite>; a. fr.
